column1: # THE TWO DISCRIMINATING WITNESSES, IN DETAIL
# BR_EMITFILE_EMIT_OBJECT -- the WP-001 REQUIRED ROUTE.
#   The mutation `if (0 && args->emit_object)` at src/main.c:250 disables
#   ONLY the object-emission arm of emitFile. The mutation was
#   compiled into a real production compiler (BUILD_RC=0), the
#   stage0 producer was held PRISTINE so that the mutation could not
#   break the toolchain, and the mutated binary was EXECUTED over
#   the required route. The observed difference is an ARTIFACT-TYPE
#   change: the compiler produced a linked EXECUTABLE where the
#   baseline produced a relocatable OBJECT. The C branch therefore
#   SELECTS the artifact type on the required route.
# BR_MAIN_PRINT_TOKENS -- the main() ACTION DISPATCH.
#   The mutation `if (0 && args.print_tokens)` at src/main.c:519
#   disables ONLY the tokens arm of the main() action dispatch. The
#   mutated compiler was built (BUILD_RC=0) and executed over
#   `-tokens input.HC`. The observed difference is the COMPLETE
#   DISAPPEARANCE of the token stream (8 stdout lines -> 0). The C
#   branch in main() therefore SELECTS the action.
# THE POLYC-OWNED LAYER, MEASURED SEPARATELY
#   The eight cli.c.o relocations are into: ClassifyOption,
#   ClassifyArgument, Decide, OptionField, ValueArgIndex,
#   ValueOffset, HostSetArgv and HostCopyValue. Five of those are
#   the C host bridge (argv install + byte copy) and three are the
#   PolyC decision layer (option classification, field selection,
#   whole-argv status). The C bridge copies a value the PolyC driver
#   chose; it does not choose.
